name: smart-student-achievement-ranking-system
description: Role-based, real-time student achievement ranking platform (MERN + Socket.IO)

scripts.setup: npm install && npm install --prefix server && npm install --prefix client
scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n SERVER,CLIENT -c blue,green "npm run dev --prefix server" "npm run dev --prefix client"
scripts.build: npm install --prefix server && npm install --prefix client --include=dev && npm run build --prefix client
